question: Which paper reports the best result on CoNLL-2000 by F1?

lines.question: Which method has the highest F1 score on CoNLL-2000?
lines.query:
# params: metric
SELECT (MIN(?name) AS ?thing) (IF(SAMPLE(?higher), SAMPLE(?best), -SAMPLE(?best)) AS ?score) (MIN(?pname) AS ?paper) WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?t (MAX(?bkey) AS ?best) WHERE {
      ?bv a ev:Value ; ev:of ?t ; ev:onMetric ?bm ; ev:number ?bnumber ; ev:inExperiment ?be ; kg:contextKey "CoNLL-2000" .
      ?bm ev:name $metrics .
      ?be ev:inPaper ?bp .
      ?bp ev:name ?bpaper .
      OPTIONAL { ?bm kg:higherIsBetter ?bh }
      BIND(IF(COALESCE(?bh, true), ?bnumber, -?bnumber) AS ?bkey)
      $include[?bpaper]
    }
    GROUP BY ?t
  }
  ?v a ev:Value ; ev:of ?t ; ev:onMetric ?m ; ev:number ?number ; ev:inExperiment ?e ; kg:contextKey "CoNLL-2000" .
  ?m ev:name $metrics .
  ?t ev:name ?name .
  ?e ev:inPaper ?p .
  ?p ev:name ?pname .
  OPTIONAL { ?m kg:higherIsBetter ?h }
  BIND(COALESCE(?h, true) AS ?higher)
  BIND(IF(?higher, ?number, -?number) AS ?key)
  FILTER(?key = ?best)
  $include[?pname]
}
GROUP BY ?t
ORDER BY DESC(SAMPLE(?best)) ?thing

lines.question: Which papers report F1 scores on CoNLL-2000?
lines.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?paper WHERE { ?v a ev:Value ; kg:side ?s ; ev:onMetric ?m ; kg:contextKey ?ctx ; ev:inExperiment ?e . ?m ev:name ?metric . ?e ev:inPaper ?p . ?p ev:name ?paper . VALUES ?s { $sides } VALUES ?metric { $metrics } FILTER(?ctx = "CoNLL-2000") }
how: It looks for papers that contain experiments measuring specific metrics on the CoNLL-2000 dataset.
The query filters for values recorded on the sides and metrics you specify.
